description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget, specifically the HomeRootScreen, which manages the presentation of the home screen in a media streaming app. It includes UI components for loading, error handling, displaying continue-watching content, and multiple content rails with interactive cards.

classes.name: HomeRootScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that serves as the main home screen for the app, displaying various content rails and managing user interactions.

classes.name: _HomeLoading
classes.description: A stateless widget showing placeholder UI while content loads.

classes.name: _HomeError
classes.description: A widget displaying an error message and a retry button.

classes.name: _HomeEmpty
classes.description: A widget shown when no content is available.

classes.name: _ContinueWatchingEmpty
classes.description: A widget indicating there is nothing in the continue watching list.

classes.name: _RailList
classes.description: A widget rendering a horizontal list of content items for a specific rail.

classes.name: _RailCardWithActions
classes.description: A widget representing a content card with action buttons for play, download, and details.

classes.name: _DownloadButton
classes.description: A widget that displays the download state and allows starting/canceling downloads.

methods.name: _railControllerForId
methods.description: Returns or creates a ScrollController for a given rail ID.

methods.name: _setInteractingDebounced
methods.description: Updates user interaction state with debounce to prevent rapid toggling.

methods.name: _navigateToPlayerSync
methods.description: Navigates to the media player screen for a specific content ID and optional start position.

methods.name: _enqueueDownloadSync
methods.description: Enqueues a download request for a content item.

methods.name: _formatPosition
methods.description: Formats position seconds into a human-readable string.
